description: This file defines the EnumCasesFunction class, which extends FunctionExpression, providing functionality to compile enum case calls within Twig templates. It handles arguments, checks for enum existence, and generates the appropriate code to invoke enum cases.

classes.name: EnumCasesFunction
classes.description: A class that extends FunctionExpression, providing specialized compilation for enum case handling within Twig templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the function call, checking arguments, ensuring the first argument is a string representing an enum, and generating code for enum cases.
